title: carex breviculmis var. montivaga

It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Carex breviculmis var. montivaga include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help in easing congestion and promoting healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are yet to be fully researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that contribute to its medicinal properties.
